protocol_metadata.about: Frax USD (frxUSD) is a fiat-redeemable, fully-collateralized stablecoin issued by the Frax Finance Protocol on Ethereum and 12+ additional chains. Users mint frxUSD 1:1 by depositing USDC, USDT, PYUSD, bank wires, or tokenized treasuries via the FraxNet platform; the stablecoin is backed by tokenized U.S. Treasury assets including BlackRock BUIDL and Superstate USTB. Governance-approved 'enshrined custodians' are entities that can mint and burn frxUSD against provable cash-equivalent reserves via dedicated frxUSDCustodian contracts. Holders can deposit frxUSD into the sfrxUSD savings vault to earn daily interest derived from institutional Treasury fund yields.
